title: West Coast Swing Basic Steps (Everyone teaches this wrong)

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates the full dance sequence first, explains that complex moves are just variations of five basic elements, and then breaks down each core move step by step.
method.signature: Demonstrating the entire set of basic patterns upfront to show how simple the dance actually is before breaking them down.

practices.what: Demonstrates the complete sequence of basic West Coast Swing moves to music.
Breaks down the first basic move, the side pass, explaining footwork and path.
Introduces the sugar push, explaining timing and common pitfalls.
Explains the rolling pass and its similarities to previous patterns.
Demonstrates the basic whip pattern and discusses its eight-count structure.

adaptations.difficulty: Doing a side pass under the arm instead of outside the shoulder
adaptations.adjustment: Step out of the way and let the follower travel under the arm to the other side

beliefs.belief: West Coast Swing is not as complicated as people think and can be simplified into five core components.

moments.says: The teacher introduces Anthony and Rose to cover the overall view of West Coast Swing and promises to simplify it.
The teacher explains that after demonstrating the five basic things, they will break them down into hundreds of different patterns.
The teacher names a common mistake dance teachers and new dancers make by learning the sugar push first.
The teacher laughs off a humorous moment on set and checks in on what just happened.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling equipped to master West Coast Swing through simplified core patterns.

struggles.theme: Overwhelmed by the variety and complexity of WCS moves
Figuring out what the lead wants without knowing all options

clicked.theme: Simplifying the steps into 5 clear parts brought lightbulb moments
Clear and concise teaching pace without being too slow

requests.theme: Would love to see solo practice videos for drills at home
Wanted to see the instructor incorporate all 5 moves to music at the end

meant.theme: Gave the confidence to go out and try dancing at a club

method.limits: Audio and visual content only cover the first ten minutes of instruction and explanation.
